=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:86-91 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `_directory_file_map` reads every file as UTF-8 text, so a non-UTF-8 or binary artifact will raise `UnicodeDecodeError` instead of producing a comparison failure.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers noted there is no fallback or error handling; the current harness is text-only, but this code would crash if the renderer ever emitted non-text output.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:86-91 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `_directory_file_map` loads the full contents of every rendered file into memory as text, which is unnecessary and can scale poorly as the harness grows.
  WHY: The reviewer explicitly called this a scalability concern rather than a correctness bug.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:448-452 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `differing_files` is checked against a hardcoded set of four paths, so legitimate changes to which templates depend on `{{ output_root_name }}` will fail this test.
  WHY: Reviewers noted this is an intentional contract check, but it still requires manual test updates when the affected file set changes.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:458-465 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `files_a[rel_path].replace("out-a", "out-b") == files_b[rel_path]` assumes every `out-a` occurrence is the basename substitution, so unrelated literal matches can make the check fail or misclassify the diff.
  WHY: All reviewers who flagged it described the same blind string-replacement assumption; it works for the current templates but is fragile.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:430-460 | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The new basename-sensitive comparison test only covers the `python-mongo-flask` family, so the separate `python-mongo-repo-checks` family is not exercised here.
  WHY: The reviewer noted the scope was acceptable for the PR, but the coverage gap was still called out for completeness.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:427-465 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `test_renderer_output_root_basename_only_affects_expected_files` loads full rendered file texts into memory for comparison instead of a cheaper hashed or streaming approach.
  WHY: The reviewer flagged this as a scalability concern if the rendered output set grows.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:412-419 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The deterministic-output test assumes the renderer derives `output_root_name` solely from the leaf basename of `output_root`.
  WHY: If the renderer ever used a different naming rule, the same-basename path change would not guarantee identical output and the test would fail unexpectedly.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:458-460 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `replace("out-a", "out-b")` equality check assumes that every occurrence of the literal string `out-a` in `files_a[rel_path]` corresponds exclusively to an `output_root_name` substitution.
  WHY: If a future template change introduced the literal string `out-a` or `out-b` in non-path content, the check could false-fail or false-pass.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:430-460
  PROBLEM: The new basename-sensitive comparison test only covers the `python-mongo-flask` family, so the separate `python-mongo-repo-checks` family is not exercised here.
  WHY: The reviewer noted the scope was acceptable for the PR, but the coverage gap was still called out for completeness.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:86-91 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_directory_file_map` reads all files with `.read_text(encoding="utf-8")` without error handling.
  WHY: If the renderer ever emits a non-UTF-8 or binary file, the test will crash with `UnicodeDecodeError` instead of producing a meaningful comparison failure.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:448-452 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The assertion `differing_files == {...}` hard-codes the exact set of files expected to vary with `output_root_name`.
  WHY: If a template is added or removed that uses `{{ output_root_name }}`, the test will fail on a legitimate renderer change.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:458-465 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The assertion `files_a[rel_path].replace("out-a", "out-b") == files_b[rel_path]` assumes `out-a` appears only as the intended substitution.
  WHY: If `out-a` appears in multiple places or in unrelated text, the comparison can misclassify correct renders as failures.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:86-91 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_directory_file_map` loads every rendered file's full content into memory as text.
  WHY: While acceptable for current test scale, this approach does not scale well as the validation harness grows.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:458-465 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The assertion `files_a[rel_path].replace("out-a", "out-b") == files_b[rel_path]` performs a blind string replacement on the entire file content.
  WHY: If `out-a` or `out-b` appears outside the `{{ output_root_name }}` substitution, the replacement can produce a false negative or mask a mismatch.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:86-91 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The function reads every file with `.read_text(encoding="utf-8")` without any handling for files that are not valid UTF-8 text.
  WHY: If the validation renderer ever emits a binary or non-UTF-8 file, `read_text` raises `UnicodeDecodeError` and the entire test crashes rather than producing a meaningful comparison failure.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:86-91 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_directory_file_map` calls `path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")` on every rendered file discovered via `rglob("*")` without checking file type or handling `UnicodeDecodeError`.
  WHY: If the renderer outputs binary or non-UTF8 content, the test crashes with `UnicodeDecodeError` instead of a graceful assertion failure.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:448-452 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test hardcodes the exact set of basename-sensitive files for the `python-mongo-flask` family.
  WHY: Adding or removing `{{ output_root_name }}` in a template will legitimately change the set and fail the test until it is updated.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:458-465 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `files_a[rel_path].replace("out-a", "out-b") == files_b[rel_path]` assumes the basename appears only in the intended substitution context.
  WHY: If the basename appears elsewhere or in multiple places, the comparison can either pass falsely or fail on correct output.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:427-465 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new test loads full rendered file texts into memory instead of using a cheaper hash-based or streaming comparison.
  WHY: Larger rendered outputs would increase memory use and timeout risk.
- tests/test_render_validation_templates.py:412-419 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The path change to `first-parent/validation` and `second-parent/validation` assumes the renderer derives `output_root_name` from the leaf basename only.
  WHY: If the renderer used the full path or another naming rule, the determinism check would fail unexpectedly.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
